column1: # Upstream source of everything vendored under plugins/ and tools/. The map
#   dir  = a plugin directory under plugins/, or a path from the repo root for anything
#   repo = `-` means no upstream to pull from: authored here, or the source is not
#          yet confirmed. revendor.sh skips those rows and says so.
#   ref  = a tag, a branch, or `latest` (revendor.sh resolves `latest` to the newest
#          release, then the newest version tag, then the default branch HEAD). Every
#          pull records its commit in sources.lock.tsv, so a branch still shows drift.
#   path = `.` for the whole repository, or one directory inside it. A directory lands
#          at the same relative path under <dir>, with the upstream licence files next
#          to it; the rest of <dir> is ours and is left alone.
# Never leave a field empty: tab is whitespace to `read`, so an empty field shifts
# every column after it. Use `-` or `.`.
# Verified against the GitHub API on 2026-08-16. A row is only as good as that check:
# nine of these were first guessed by scanning each plugin's own README, and three of
# the guesses pointed at the wrong repository entirely. Confirm before you add a row.
# The tools/ rows were added on 2026-09-25 and confirmed by content rather than by
# README: each vendored copy was diffed against the upstream tree it came from.
